about.title: The view is the point
about.lede: The Orion is built around its glass, with the benches laid out the way you want.
items: Bronze tempered glass runs across the front and side, so every seat looks out.
Start with back-wall benches (A), then add a short door-wall bench (B), a long side bench (C) or a short side bench (D). Ask us which suits your group.
3" of foam in the floor, walls and roof keeps the heat in on cold nights.
With this much glass there is no safe clearance for a wood stove, so the Orion uses an electric heater.
